title: text paragraphs 1
content:
On December 16, 2025, the Creating Helpful Incentives to Produce Semiconductors (CHIPS) Program Office (CPO) within the U.S. Department of Commerce completed the Record of Decision (ROD) for the Final Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) for the proposed Micron New York Semiconductor Manufacturing Project. This ROD states the CPO’s decision to approve disbursements of Federal financial assistance under the terms of the CHIPS Incentives Program award to Micron for Micron’s Proposed Project in Clay, New York, as described in the ROD and in the EIS as the Preferred Action Alternative. The Preferred Action Alternative of the Final EIS furthers the purpose and satisfies the need for the project, including by meeting the national need to increase memory chips production. The Biological Opinion (BO) and Programmatic Agreement (PA) have been completed, and the BO is provided as Attachment 1 to this ROD. The First Amendment to the Programmatic Agreement was completed on September 28, 2026. A link to the ROD, PA, First Amendment to the PA, and Final EIS and all appendices can be found below.
